nom: Peter Thomas Roth Retinol Fusion PM Night Serum

segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and good tolerance (e.g. rosacea, sensitivity to fragrance/actives), though one reviewer without sensitive skin still broke out badly.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers say the serum does not dry out or flake their skin and even helps with flaking under makeup, though one dry-skin reviewer with fair skin saw no change in discoloration.
segments.oily: Oily and acne-prone reviewers (including one with PCOS) report clearer pores, less texture and no purge when paired with a fuller routine.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s and 60s report smoother texture, faded fine lines and more even tone, though a couple in their late 40s/50s saw no visible change in existing wrinkles.
segments.combination: One reviewer with textured, blemish-prone and acne-scarred skin (implying combination-type concerns) reports texture eliminated and scars fading.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother fine lines, softened forehead/eye lines and more even tone over weeks to months; several others (ages 40s-60s) say they saw no change in their existing wrinkles despite months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Several dry or sensitive reviewers say the serum does not dry out their skin and even adds glow or softness; one reviewer switched from a stronger 2% retinol specifically because that one was too drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea says her skin looks less red and blotchy in the morning; another with generally sensitive skin reports no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight an initial 'purge' with flaking, redness or peeling as skin adjusts, while many others report zero irritation from the start.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report faded discoloration, brighter tone and fewer dark/acne marks with continued use; one fair-skinned reviewer noted no change in discoloration after two weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or cystic-scarred skin report scars filling in, fewer breakouts and clearer skin over weeks to months; conversely, multiple reviewers describe new breakouts, trail-like acne or painful cystic pimples after starting.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers describe the serum as absorbing quickly without greasiness and helping clear clogged pores over about a month.

aspects.libelle: Dropper prone to leaking or loosening
Silky, smooth skin feel after use
High price justified by longevity of bottle
Very thin, runny texture hard to control
Purge phase with flaking or redness

extraits.texte: I was really excited to try this product, given the great reviews. I had been using retinol products for about a year now and really liked how they help control my adult acne. I don't know if it's the formulation or what, but this product created an absolute nightmare for my skin. I had huge, painful, cystic acne in some places and peeling in others. At first I told myself I was purging due to the strength of the product- then my husband finally convinced me that it was making things worse. When I stopped using the product, my skin started to heal- but it was a slow process, and I still have hyper-pigmentation and scarring. I love other PTR products, but this one obviously did't jive with my skin. Thank goodness for Ulta's awesome return policy!

I have strange skin. Rosacea and a whole host of other issues. I didn't think this was doing much for me after a couple of months, and stopped using. Then I realized that it had made a difference after I stopped. It was subtle for me, but it did make my skin look better. Mainly what I notice is that my skin looks better in the morning. I don't feel the need to rush and put on makeup. It looks more even and not as red and blotchy in the morning. Also, it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I would recommend and will repurchase.

I've never had a retinol product before, and I'm so happy that I chose this one. (To preface what I am about to say - I have super oily and acne prone skin, due to PCOS, and have dark spots almost everywhere) I double cleanse my face with a regular gentle cleanser, and then a benzol peroxide cleanser, then go in with the retinol once my face is COMPLETELY dry. I follow that up with niacinamide serum and an Azelaic acid serum, then moisturizer and a face oil. It sounds like a lot, but it's truly not. Plus, if you want to combat the purge stage, then you're obviously going to need to put things on your skin to fight that acne. I've been doing this nightly routine for months, and I've had no purging at all, and no irritation. Results came within the first 2 weeks. I just wish the negative reviewers understood that this isn't an "all in one" product, and needs to be incorporated into a routine.

I tend to do a lot of homework before trying anything new after developing sensitivities to many common skincare ingredients and now random fragrances. I also don't want to settle for mediocre skincare, so I look for products with shorter ingredient lists & actives toward the top. This sounded ideal for my oily skin and large pores prone to clogged blackheads and whiteheads, so I was glad to find it as gentle as described with no drying at all. After a month, my pores were virtually clear and my skin was brighter. I've now used it almost nightly for 4+ months and it's become one of few products I can't imagine being without. This has the consistency of water and dries quickly with no pilling, so it's nice to be able to apply serum, moisturizer(s), etc over it within minutes. It also lasts forever since only a few drops are needed each night. I don't have many wrinkles other than a moderately-deep crease below each eye, but no change in either since starting this, so I'll likely try another PTR product with a higher percentage of retinol to see if that makes a difference. If you have sensitive skin and/or don't want to deal with the dryness & peeling associated with other retinol products, I definitely recommend giving this one a try. Tip- it's very thin, so use the dropper to place a drop on each part of your face, then quickly smooth it in. (I tried using my hands, but it mainly ended up down my arms and on the counter.)

I am 35, have fair and very dry skin. I'm a non smoker and have never been a sun worshiper. Unfortunately, my fair skin still has its fair share of discoloration and my tiny pores as a teenager have started to enlarge with age. In the past I used prescription retinols and those would always irritate my sensitive skin and make me unbelievably dry even though I use great moisturizers. I bought this along with PTR Unwrinkle Peel Pads and within just two weeks I've noticed my enlarged pores are non existent! I haven't noticed any change in the discoloration yet. This does not dry my skin out. It actually gives it a glow that I absolutely love!

I have very difficult skin. Very sensitive, acne, dry flakes, hyperpigmentation, finelines, the works. I use nightly on clean, dry skin. I have noticed a huge change in my skin texture and my breakouts. No difference so far in fine lines but even if it doesn't help that at all I will continue to use this product because I'm so pleased with the results.

I usually am very retinol sensitive (peeling, flakey, dry, painful). I love that I could bath in this and not have a bad reaction ever. But, after using for a few years, I don't feel like I am/have seen any results. I am 46 and still look mid-30s so maybe. But I don't feel like I look any more youthful (collagen plumped) that before I started. I still use it, but am looking around for stronger options and also contemplating the Lancer Method (physical exfoliate, cleanse, nourish/moisturize). It seems to have gotten some awesome results for Candace Cameron Bure.
